name: Gyre-Carling

attributes.attribute: An alternate name for the spinner spirit Habetrot.
A healing spirit; those she wove a garment for never fell ill.
In some areas she was a fairy queen who stole flax left unspun at the year's end.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gyre-Carling is an alternate name for the spinner spirit Habetrot. See the entry for Habetrot. Those whom this healing fairy wove a garment for never fell ill. In some areas she appeared as a fairy queen, Gyre-Carling or Gy-Carlin, who stole any flax left unspun at the end of a year.

okr.objective: Clarify Gyre-Carling as an alternate name of the healing fairy spinner Habetrot.
key_results: Gyre-Carling is another name for the fairy Habetrot
Habetrot was a healing spirit whose garments kept the wearer free of illness
As a fairy queen Gyre-Carling stole flax left unspun at the end of a year
